pairs.subject: design-tokens
pairs.evidence: components/ui/Primitives.tsx:50 UI primitives and components conditionally branch on theme identity to fork DOM structure and styling rather than resolving visual decisions through unified semantic tokens rebound at the scope root.

techniques.evidence: components/ui/GravitoneTokens.tsx:17 Server-rendered style tag emits all tokens from the TypeScript authority into CSS custom properties, realizing single-source cross-runtime generation.
components/ui/deck/DeckCard.tsx:90 Density is implemented as component props ('density="dense"', 'size="sm"') with markup forks rather than scope-root token rebinding.
components/ui/tokens.ts:98 No duration ladder or role-named easings exist in tokens, and reduced motion relies on 'animation: none !important' and per-component branching.
components/ui/Primitives.tsx:50 Components branch on theme identity ('useWorld() === "almanac"') to render structural variants rather than rebinding semantic variables at the root.
components/ui/tokens.ts:21 Tailwind utility classes are explicitly exempted from the token discipline, allowing components to consume raw palette values without linting.
components/ui/tokens.ts:162 Token names encode literal color values ('cyan') instead of semantic intent, and components consume Tailwind palette primitives directly.
